image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a marine fish, identified as a Rock Beauty (Holocanthus tricolor). The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body/head and golden-yellow posterior body. The image is somewhat low-resolution with visible digital noise/compression artifacts. The background consists of blurry reef structures.

A large, dark eye is clearly visible on the black portion of the head, consistent with the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible torso exhibits the high, laterally compressed profile typical of angelfish/butterflyfish.

Significant blur and noise in the background and along the lower belly edge. While this could be depth-of-field, the transition between the fish and the background has slight 'haloing' indicative of generative blending.
